scope: Documented Zijing student-apartment numbers 1–23; not an independently certified current inventory or proof that later numbers do not exist.

mapIdentity.method: Frozen map POI labels plus local osm-names.json named-way boundaries. Three shared named-way boundary lines partition the original map polygon; no source root, footprint, hole or origin is replaced.

sources.title: 清华加快建设学生公寓学术交流空间
sources.author: 记者 王冰冰
sources.supports: Historical occupancy: 1–13 undergraduate; 14–17 and half of 18 doctoral. W connecting portions contain glass triangular exchange halls.
sources.limits: Historical occupancy is not a current allocation guarantee. Inline photo is indoors, not an exterior reference. No metre heights or authoritative floor count.

sources.title: 校园景观换新颜：更美的清华等你回家！

sources.limits: Trees obscure the facades. Group identification only; does not establish individual seams, floor counts or glass-hall dimensions. Title-image photographer credit is not assigned to this image.

sources.title: 学生食堂
sources.supports: Zijing dining: five floors including one basement; Taoli dining: four including one basement. Exterior identification-card insets.
sources.limits: Four/three above-ground floors follow arithmetically. Insets are small and cropped; curved facade spans, metre dimensions and rear surfaces remain estimates.

constructionContract.lowRise: 1–13: seven-floor OSM annotation; group-photo pitched roofs, repeated projecting balcony piers and pale gables. Roof colour assigned by group location is explicitly estimated.
constructionContract.doctoralW: 14–17: W-shaped frozen footprint and official group-labelled exterior. Fourteen visible-floor rhythm and 3.18m storeys are modeling estimates, not verified measured heights/floor counts.
constructionContract.otherHighRise: 18: separate identity, eleven-floor family estimate only. 19/21/22/23: officially stated eleven floors. 20: eleven-floor local OSM annotation, not independently verified in the accommodation guide.
constructionContract.facades: Real holes between masonry piers, recessed glass, frames, slab edges and open rails. Repeated bays/entrances and hidden faces are typology estimates, not per-building photo verification.
constructionContract.rights: Reference images remain unbundled and are never used as facade textures. All materials and number glyphs are original procedural geometry.
